name: How can I check if I have a water leak using my water meter?

mainEntity.name: How can I check if I have a water leak using my water meter?

acceptedAnswer.text: To check for a leak, first ensure all water-using appliances and fixtures inside and outside your home are completely turned off. Locate your water meter and observe the leak indicator, which is often a small red or blue triangle, a silver wheel, or a sweep hand. If this indicator is still moving, even slowly, it confirms that water is flowing through your meter, indicating a leak. If there's no indicator, note the meter reading, wait 15-30 minutes without using any water, and then check the reading again. Any change confirms a leak.
acceptedAnswer.description: Turn off all water, then check your water meter's leak indicator (small triangle/wheel) or note the reading. If it moves or changes, you likely have a leak.
